compliance.emissions: FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015

environmental.storage-temp-datasheet: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet

features.encryption: none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12
features.optics-qsfp-dd: each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
features.optics-qsfp28: each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)
features.precision-timing: PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs

management.console: RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control

physical.size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
physical.weight: 14.8 kg (32.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 (guide Table 1); 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg) in the data sheet

platform.software: EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet

power.power-draw-note: Data sheet: "346 W / 845 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD.

thermal.airflow: front-to-rear or rear-to-front, set by the fan modules and supplies fitted

gaps.note: The 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 carry TunnelSec encryption on all ports, the K builds the large-routes licence (over 5M routes), and the -S builds secure boot, where the 7280CR3A-24D12 has none of them. No configuration can state a device attribute (open gap #1237, accepted for now, decided 2026-10-23), so the device carries the base switch's features line and its encryption line names all three. The data sheet gives the builds one set of hardware figures.

The guide has no front figure for this model and the data sheet's photograph is 463 px wide (0.94 px/mm), so every front position is read to about a millimetre. Legends, lamp glyphs, the speed-strip print and the port numbers are not legible in it.
gaps.wanted: a flat figure or a studio photograph of the face.

gaps.note: The port numbers printed on the metal are not legible in the photograph and no held document lists them, so no numeral is printed and the port ids follow the 7280CR3-32D4's precedent (provenance.port-numbering).
gaps.wanted: a photograph or figure of the numbered face.

gaps.note: The photograph shows two lamps a QSFP port, and Table 10 describes one port LED; the second lamp's meaning is not stated. Both are given Table 10's states.
gaps.wanted: the guide's account of the two port lamps.

gaps.note: The photograph is a picture of the K build and prints "7280CR3AK-24D12". The plain, M and K-S plates are not shown, so every configuration prints "7280CR3A-24D12".
The glyphs under the four system lamps, the legends of the Time-of-Day slot and the two clock jacks, and the symbols at the management jacks are not legible and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a flat figure or a photograph of the right-hand end of the face.

gaps.note: Neither the guide nor the data sheet names the clock connectors; they are seated as std/smb@1 from their drawn size and their direction (input or output) is not stated.
The Time-of-Day connector is seated as std/usb-c@1 because the data sheet's CAB-SYNCE-RJ names a USB-C mate.
Neither document gives the USB generation; the port is seated with the `usb2` skin as the one that claims least.
Storage temperature -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2) against -40 to 70 C (data sheet). The guide's, the newer document, is in attrs.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: The guide's chapter 3 figures are isometric drawings of another switch and carry no measure, and the kit guides for KIT-7101-D and the other spares are not held, so no ear position or rail kit is written.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the mounting bracket position, and the kit guides.

gaps.note: The PWR-1511-DC supplies are the library's existing drawing of that module, an AC housing with a plain terminal block; the guide shows a DC supply only in isometric figures.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing or photograph of the PWR-1511-DC.

gaps.note: The guide's power tables and the data sheet give whole-switch figures only; the fan modules' missing power figure (lint L27) stands. The supplies state their output.
The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis for KIT-GND-EXT-1RU (guide section 4.2, Table 5). No flat figure measures it, so it is not placed.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing of the bottom with the grounding bracket holes.

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in), 14.8 kg (32.6 lbs), the same for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12. Data sheet: 43.99 x 4.37 x 59.2 cm "inc. handles" (17.3 x 1.72 x 23.31 in), 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg). The 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.99 cm (440.0 here); the height is the data sheet's 43.7 (the guide's 4.4 rounds it) and the depth its 592.0. 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is #aaabad, the 7280CR3-32D4's reading of the same family's plate (the photograph's plate reads a similar light grey).

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7280CR3A-24D12-F and -R, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12-F and -R, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12-F and -R, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12-S-F and -S-R ("secure boot enabled"), each "2 x AC", F for front to rear and R for rear to front air. The "#" orders ("configurable fans and psu") are orders of parts and are not listed. The A, M, K and K-S builds share the face, size, weight and supplies and differ in encryption, routes and secure boot, which a configuration cannot state: see the gap config-scoped-device-attrs. The data sheet lists no DC part number for the switch (the PWR-1511-DC-RED and -BLUE supplies are spares), so the DC builds are examples. The suffix -S in this family is secure boot, not an empty-bay build, and the guide draws no blank for a bay, so no configuration shows an open bay.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide's chapter 3 mounts the 1RU switch with the accessory-kit brackets in isometric drawings of another switch that carry no measure, and the kit guides are not held. The data sheet lists KIT-7101-D, KIT-7101-RK, KIT-7101-LD-RK and KIT-ADJ-RLR. No ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -40 to 70 C, humidity 5 to 90 percent, altitude 0 to 3,000 m. Only the storage temperature differs; the guide's, the newer document, is in attrs.

front-legend.note: A grey plate at the left, 0.4 to 11.4 mm across, carries the maker's wordmark in its lower half (turned to read upward) and the model line in its upper half. THE WORDMARK IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved. The model line is plain text and is set as "7280CR3A-24D12"; the photograph prints "7280CR3AK-24D12" because it is a picture of the K build, and the M and K plates are not shown, so the same line is set on every configuration (gap model-plates).

front-ports.note: THIRTY-SIX CAGES IN THREE BLOCKS OF SIX COLUMNS OF TWO, counted in a six-times enlargement of the photograph and confirmed by the data sheet ("24 x QSFP100, 12 x QSFP-DD"). The left block is six stacked QSFP cages whose openings start at 12.7 mm from the left and step 19.1 mm (18 px; the registry's ganged pitch is 19.0 and is used); the middle block is six QSFP-DD cages starting at 134.7 mm on a 25.45 mm step (24 px); the right block is six QSFP cages ending at 404.0 mm, started at 290.0 mm. The rows are the upper cage 14.0 to 23.6 mm down and the lower cage 27.8 to 37.4 mm down (centres 18.8 and 32.6 mm, a 13.8 mm pitch, read from the dark openings at rows 144 to 151 and 157 to 164 px), the same grid in all three blocks. The 7280CR3-32D4 reads 15.3 mm for its 1RU stack off its guide figure; this photograph reads 13.8, one and a half millimetres short, and is used because it is this model's own picture. The registry cage sizes (std/qsfp-ganged 18.5 x 9.58, std/qsfp-dd 19.0 x 10.0) are seated centred on the measured openings, which read 17 to 18 px wide and 8 px tall (the photograph shows the dark interior and not the bezel). The belly-to-belly turn (upper cage upright, lower turned 180) is the library's convention; the photograph cannot show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E: "All fans and power supplies are hot swappable" and "all slots must be filled or covered with a blank for operation". SO THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE THREE FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit; the management ports are part of the chassis and are placements on the front. The held documents draw no blank for either bay, so none is modelled.

gate-1-front.note: THE FRONT IS DRAWN FROM THE DATA SHEET'S PHOTOGRAPH (page 6, "Arista 7280CR3A-24D12"), an embedded 463 x 282 px raster whose chassis fills 415 px across (x 24 to 438) and 43 px down (y 130 to 172). It is a near-straight-on render. Gate 1: 415 px across 440.0 mm gives 0.943 px/mm; 43 px down 43.7 mm gives 0.984 px/mm. They differ by four percent, which is one pixel of the height (the photograph's lower edge carries a lip or shadow row), so the face is near-orthographic and fractions along x are good to a pixel, along y to about a pixel and a half. 0.943 px/mm is used on both axes, so one pixel is 1.06 mm and EVERY FRONT POSITION BELOW IS ESTIMATED to about 1 mm. The scale anchor is the 440.0 mm body (the data sheet's 43.99 cm over the handles, left edge read at x 24 and right at x 438). The measure is a dark-run scan of the cage openings along x at the upper row and along y down two columns, read with a six-times enlargement beside it for the counts.

gate-1-rear.note: The guide draws the rear generically (D-1 to D-4) and does not say which model uses which. This model has three fan modules and is 1RU, so it is mapped to figure D-2 ("Rear Panel with Three Fan Modules (1RU)"), at the positions the 7280CR3-32D4 file read off the same figure (PS1 at 4.0 mm, PS2 at 362.3 mm, fans 78.6 mm wide at 107.7, 191.0 and 274.3 mm, 1.85 and 2.55 mm down). THE MAPPING IS ESTIMATED: it follows from fan count (data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3"), height and supply count, not from a caption. Figure D-2 also draws a management-port block beside the first supply; it is not drawn here because this model carries its management ports on the FRONT (the data sheet's photograph) and the data sheet's three-fan rear view shows no jacks.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-24 for an end-of-sale notice for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12: none found for this family (the notices found are for older 7280 models), so the field reads none-announced.

management-ports.note: A block at the right, 416.0 to 435.4 mm across and 5.3 to 41.1 mm down, holds three stacked jacks: the Ethernet management port at the top (with its two lamps), the USB port and the serial console at the bottom, the order of the DR3A-54's figure C-1 callouts 3 to 5. The jacks are seated at the library's sizes (RJ-45 15.8 x 13.2, USB 12.0 x 4.5) spread over the block; the photograph's openings read 10.6 and 8.4 mm tall, the dark inside of the jack. Guide section 4.5: "For most models, the front panel contains the console, management, and USB ports"; the data sheet: "100/1000 Mgmt Ports 1", "USB Ports 1", "RS-232 Serial Ports 1 (RJ-45)". The management port is taken as 10/100/1000 (guide 4.5) and so 1g.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. The guide's installation figures are isometric. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis for the KIT-GND-EXT-1RU kit (guide section 4.2, Table 5); no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2 and Table 10: port LEDs sit near their ports (off link down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics). The photograph shows two green dots above each upper QSFP cage, at its left and right corners, and two below each lower one (a pair at each boundary between columns), so each QSFP port carries two lamps; each QSFP-DD cage carries one, beside it (the left of an upper cage, the right of a lower one). The second QSFP lamp's meaning is not stated; both take Table 10's states. Positions are read to a pixel.

port-numbering.note: THE PHOTOGRAPH'S PORT NUMBERS ARE NOT LEGIBLE (the speed strips carry about 4 px of print) AND NO DOCUMENT HELD LISTS THEM, so no numeral is printed. The ids follow the 7280CR3-32D4's precedent, whose 400G cages in the middle carry the numbers after the 100G ones: the 24 QSFP cages are port-1 to port-24 (left block 1 to 12, right block 13 to 24) and the 12 QSFP-DD cages in the middle are port-25 to port-36, the odd number the upper cage of each column. ESTIMATED; a photograph of the face or a figure closes it. EOS names ports Ethernet1 and up and Management1; they are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4 reads "TBD" for the power draw of all three builds. The data sheet gives 346 W typical and 845 W maximum (typical "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers"), used here. Supported supplies: Table 4 and section 4.4 name PWR-1511-AC and PWR-1511-DC; the data sheet's table and ordering information name the same, with the PWR-1511-AC-RED and -BLUE spares.

rear.note: Figure D-2 at the 7280CR3-32D4's reading: three fan modules 78.6 mm wide and 38.6 mm tall and two supplies 73.5 mm wide (the data sheet's "73.5MM") and 40.0 mm tall. The data sheet's three-fan rear view (page 6, the second picture) shows the same: a supply at each end, three red modules between.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)", "Fan Tray FAN-7011H", spares FAN-7011H-F (front-to-rear) and FAN-7011H-R (rear-to-front). Guide section 2.1: a red handle is an air-exit module and a blue one an air-inlet module. The three fan modules are bays that accept arista/7280cr3-fan (FAN-7011H-F) or arista/7280cr3-fan-rev (FAN-7011H-R), both reused by part number from the 7280CR3-32D4.

sources.note: 7280R3A Series Quick Start Guide, Arista Networks, DOC-07042-01, 59 pages, PDF created 2025-05-16 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/qsg/qsg-books/QS_7280R3A.pdf): Table 1 (dimensions and weights), Table 2 (operating and storage environment), Table 3 (power input), Table 4 (power draw and supported supplies), section 2.1 (airflow orientation, handle colour), Table 5 (1RU grounding), section 4.5 (serial and management cables), Appendix A (status indicators, tables 9 to 13), Appendix D (rear panels, figures D-1 to D-4) and Appendix E (field replacement of power supplies and fan modules). The guide has NO FRONT FIGURE for this model: Appendix C draws only the DR3A-54 and DR3A-36. 7280R3A Series Data Center Switch Router Data Sheet, Arista Networks, 04-0040-26, dated April 15th, 2025 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/Datasheets/7280R3A-Datasheet.pdf): the model comparison of the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12, the power supply specifications, the ordering information and the platform overview, whose one photograph of this face is the only front source. Held and checked first: intake COVERAGE.md, SOURCES.md (no 3D model, CAD drawing, studio photograph or Visio stencil is held; the stencil zip could not be fetched). No drawing or photograph is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings.

speed-strips.note: The photograph draws a lavender strip between the two rows under each 100G column and a smaller orange one under each 400G column, with print too small to read. They are drawn in those colours as 6.4 mm strips centred on each column, 2.0 mm tall between the rows; the print is not drawn.

status-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.1, Table 9: system status, fan status and a status lamp for each supply, four in a row at the top right of the photograph at 417.8, 422.4, 427.0 and 431.5 mm and 2.4 mm down. The glyphs printed under them are not legible, so no legend is drawn (the DR3A-54's figure prints PS1 and PS2; this photograph does not resolve them).

timing.note: A vertical Time-of-Day slot with a screw at each end at 409.9 mm across, 17.6 mm down, and two gold coax jacks below it at 409.2 mm and 30.4 and 39.2 mm down (about 4.8 mm across), a green lamp above the slot. The data sheet's "PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" and its accessory "CAB-SYNCE-RJ  Spare Time of Day adapter cable (USB-C to 2 x RJ-45)" name the functions and a USB-C mate, so the slot is seated as std/usb-c@1 turned a quarter, as the 7280DR3A-54 does, and the jacks as std/smb@1 (4.83 mm, which the photograph's size matches; an SMA is 6.35). The coax type is not stated.

vents.note: The photograph fills the spaces not taken by a cage with a dotted vent grid: a band along the top (y 1.0 to 12.4 mm), a band along the bottom (38.4 to 42.7 mm), and a column in each gap between the blocks. Each is drawn as one field in its measured extent, not hole by hole.
